Fig. 4 — Real-data validation

Calibrated on real baskets, tested on unseen households

The twin shops for households of six public datasets; simulated trips are compared with real trips it never saw, the simulator is changed where it is wrong, and the frozen configuration is evaluated on new households and later weeks — with three model families as decision makers.
